lines.text: The LORD of Hosts swears that as He has planned, so it will be.
The LORD says He will break Babylon in His land.
He will trample Assyria on His mountain and remove its yoke from His people.
This plan is devised for the land of Egypt, and His hand is stretched out over all the nations.
The LORD of Hosts has purposed, and no one can thwart Him or turn His hand back.
